structured_output.what_is_happening: BEEPLE is a pump.fun coin launched through UsePaid ("Fees to @beeple via UsePaid"), so creator fees are routed to the famous crypto-native NFT artist Beeple's X account. The GeckoTerminal social field points to a specific Beeple status (2103695634804945012), which suggests the launch was set off by a tweet from him. It bonded about 8 minutes after creation and migrated to PumpSwap. About 13–14 minutes after migration it has ~$719k of volume, 2,024 unique buyers and 1,363 unique sellers. Price is up ~4x from migration but down ~40% from its all-time high (ATH ≈ $411k market cap, now ≈ $243k), with m5 at -25%. At least 10 copycat BEEPLE tokens have appeared. This one is clearly the leader and the earliest to migrate.

narrative.description: A celebrity/creator-fee token: fees go to Beeple, a well-known crypto artist with a large audience, apparently tied to a specific Beeple tweet. If Beeple acknowledges it, claims the fees or posts about it, the coin can re-rate sharply. Crypto-native figures sometimes do engage.
narrative.why_spreading: A famous crypto name plus a fee-sharing hook drew a fast wave of ~2k unique buyers within 15 minutes. The copycats show traders are chasing the ticker. There is no confirmation that Beeple endorses it.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the earliest-migrated, highest-volume and highest-market-cap BEEPLE. It links to Beeple's X account and a specific status, and its fees route to @beeple via UsePaid. It looks like the canonical UsePaid launch.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 same-name tokens. Two have meaningful volume (4So8…, 2sRF…, ~$17k market cap each with $135–168k h1 volume); the rest are small or dead. All launched after this one.

authenticity.evidence: 2,024 unique buyers against 1,363 unique sellers is broad participation, and there are 41 smart wallets and 2 renowned wallets. However, GMGN counts 494 bundler wallets and 596 fresh wallets, the bot/degen rate is 65%, and the top bundler holds 30.7%. No paid DexScreener boosts or ads.
authenticity.uncertainty: Whether Beeple has engaged at all is unknown. The bundler count may reflect platform/launch mechanics or snipe bots rather than one coordinated insider.

structural_risks: 494 bundler wallets; the top bundler trader holds 30.7%
65% bot/degen rate; high turnover (16x per hour) points to churn
Already 40% below ATH with strong m5 selling
Liquidity of ~$45k is thin against the sell pressure
The deployer is a platform address with 166k launches, so its history says nothing about this token

structured_output.counterargument: Tokens tied to a celebrity without the celebrity's consent usually peak in the first 10–20 minutes, when the snipers and bundlers who created the pump exit. The -25% to -41% m5 candle may be the start of that unwind, and the copycats split the demand. If Beeple ignores the coin or disowns it, the likely path is a slow bleed through the -50% stop, not a 2x back above the ATH.
unknowns: Whether Beeple has tweeted about the token or claimed the fees

structured_output.thesis: This is the canonical token for a famous crypto name, with real breadth: ~2k buyers, burned LP, no creator holdings and clean authorities. Beeple engaging is the tail that could take it well above a $500k market cap. Against that, heavy bundling and bots and a fresh dump from the ATH make the stop just as likely. Its odds of reaching 2x rank above the typical coin in this pool, but they are far from a sure thing.
